reviewer: Claude (visual inspection of the contact sheets: views, forms, closeups, plus stats.json)
notes: v1 is the jerrycan as it exists in build_props4.py. The harness' first lighting was blown out and the wire view was black; both were harness bugs fixed before this review (renders_superseded_* keeps the bad ones).

defects.text: Top of the can is a hip-roof/pyramid wedge (upper vertices pulled in) instead of a flat top with shoulders; the front, side and three-quarter silhouettes are wrong.
defects.fix: Rebuild the body as a rounded box with a flat top and only a small fillet.

defects.text: The three-bar handle, the can's defining feature, is missing: only thin slivers are visible above the top (close_cap_handle).
defects.fix: Model a raised handle block with four posts and three grip openings, spanning most of the top.

defects.text: The X and the two rails are flat bars laid over the face like planks; they overlap the dished panel edge, stand clear of the surface in the side views, and are not pressed ribs.
defects.fix: Make low trapezoid ribs half-sunk into a flat panel face, ending inside a pressed frame.

defects.text: The body shell renders as untextured white in every view; only the dished panel carries the paint texture (bad UV or material assignment on the body faces).
defects.fix: Rebuild with per-face box UVs in metres and check all faces show the paint texture.

defects.text: Spout is a tiny flat octagon: no flip cap, cam lever or retainer ring.
defects.fix: Add a flanged spout, a flip cap, a short lever and a ring.

defects.text: No recessed seam around the middle of the narrow faces (Wikipedia: recessed welded seam).
defects.fix: Add a shallow groove along y=0 across top, ends and bottom.

defects.text: Height is 0.490 m against 0.46 +-0.012 m (numeric check fails).
defects.fix: Body 0.40 m plus handle to 0.46 m.

defects.text: Nine material slots are attached but only two are used: 87.8 MB of texture memory for a 0.35 m prop.
defects.fix: Attach only the olive-paint and grey-steel materials.

defects.text: All edges are sharp; pressed steel cans have rounded edges and shoulders.
defects.fix: Round the body edges with a rounded-box mapping (radius about 2 cm).
